    segments = case['segments']
    budget = case['budget']
    
    # Initialize allocations at minimum quotas
    allocations = [seg['minimum'] for seg in segments]
    current_total = sum(allocations)
    remaining = budget - current_total
    
    # While there is budget left and we can allocate more
    while remaining > 0:
        best_index = -1
        best_score = -1.0
        
        for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
            if allocations[i] < seg['capacity']:
                # Next position after allocating one more token
                next_pos = allocations[i] + 1
                score = seg['importance'] / next_pos
                if score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_index = i
        
        if best_index == -1:
            # No segment can take more tokens; break to avoid infinite loop
            break
        
        allocations[best_index] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    
    total = sum(allocations)
    by_name = {segments[i]['name']: allocations[i] for i in range(len(segments))}
    
    return {
        'allocations': allocations,
        'by_name': by_name,
        'total': total
    }
